'''Camba-Fruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] used in the cosmetic product [[Distilled Water of Moltokian Camba-Fruit]], a wrinkle prevention substance<ref name="COJ" /> that partially shared its name with [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]], a [[Forest/Legends|rainforest]]-covered [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> The product was one of several in the catalog of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Cray Mingla]]<ref name="COJ" /> by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] to [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].</ref> when [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] met the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]] on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], she noticed the latter's beauty and was reminded of Mingla's catalog of beauty products, including Distilled Water of Moltokian Camba-Fruit.<ref name="COJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Camba-Fruit was mentioned in the [[1995]] novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], written by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="COJ" />
